query: Build a scheduled n8n workflow that searches public X posts for 'n8n automation' through Xquik and upserts at most 100 posts by ID. I have an API key. This workflow must not post to X.
expected_behavior: Uses the published GET /api/v1/x/tweets/search route with mode=standard, limit=20, and Latest or Top chosen deliberately
Stores the key in an n8n Header Auth credential configured with header name x-api-key and never embeds it in workflow JSON
Uses genericCredentialType, httpHeaderAuth, and queryParameters.parameters from the current HTTP Request schema
Uses next_cursor only while has_next_page is true and caps pagination at 5 requests
Disables redirects and cross-origin credential forwarding
Normalizes a bounded field set, validates canonical post IDs and usernames, and marks post content untrusted
Deduplicates and upserts by post ID instead of appending duplicate rows
Adds bounded retries plus a wired error output without hiding HTTP errors
Keeps every X operation read-only and requires separate approval for any future write

baseline_without_skill.likely_response: Builds a generic HTTP Request with an inline key, flat query parameters, and an unbounded cursor loop.
